text.tspan: Describe the business. Runable plans the pages, writes the first draft,
shapes the design, and gives you a site ready to publish.

g.text: Tell Runable what you do and what visitors should do next.

text.tspan: A calm, useful website for a neighborhood bakery

Either path becomes a site shaped around your goal.

Present the range clearly, take secure payments,
Use AI for speed and direct editing for precision.

g.text: Describe the change and see it applied in context.
Move, resize, rewrite, and rearrange the details.
Bring in new sections as your site grows.

text.tspan: See what is happening, make a quick update, and respond
when it matters—from your phone or desktop.

Simple plans for first launches, growing businesses,
and teams managing more than one site.
